problem.loss: mean over samples of half squared output-error norm
problem.schedule: branch phase then one fusion step every fusion_interval rounds; all variants share initialization and data

scope: single-process end-to-end toy regression; exact dense response oracle; honest numerical summaries

accounting.wire: float64 payload plus 128 bytes per unicast; all attempts, commits, invalidations and rebuilt matrices charged
accounting.provisioning: fixed input distribution included; preinstalled code, initial weights and central labels excluded equally
accounting.queries: all response and direction queries execute centrally on retained dense oracle; kernel counts included
accounting.rejected_candidates: no feature upload or true-loss evaluation; rejection can be conservative
accounting.backprop: fusion frozen in branch phase; true full-network chain rule each local step, then same separate fusion schedule
accounting.time: local simulator wall time; not a distributed speed benchmark

retained_arrays.scope: retained ndarray storage at observation points; excludes transient buffers, not measured peak RAM
